narratives.Description: A stable cut has no single command today: the operator runs about 15 runbook steps and is pulled back in to cut and to mint after the release PR merges (#6876, S3 of #6845). This story adds the `deft release:run <version>` verb with readiness before any write, the run record at `.deft-scratch/release-run/<version>.json` and the single up-front approval that the S2 gates (#6875) accept. It builds clauses 1, 2, 4, 13, 15 and 31 of the accepted #6845 lean 7032154033 (split comment 7048165729); the S4 (#6877) and S5 (#6878) clauses stay out.
narratives.Overview:
A stable cut has no single command: the operator runs about 15 runbook steps and is pulled back in to cut and to mint after the release PR merges. This story adds the `deft release:run <version>` verb with readiness, the run record and the single up-front approval (#6845). In the clauses, B is the cut base (the fetched delivery-branch tip), T is the tree of the release commit and M is the merged release commit.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] One verb. `deft release:run <version>` runs in order: readiness; setup (release branch from the fetched tip B, `session:start --primary-claim-exception=release-cut`, cut context); the local cut (Steps 1 to 9, no push); approve; push and open the release PR; review wait and merge; finish (tag, draft release, clear the cut context); npm publish watch; draft flip and closeout; promote only when its grant was minted. It ends by printing the pin PR, `release:local-update` and `npm i -g` commands.
- [ ] Readiness before any write: the Phase 1 checks, the Phase 2 dry run, a free tag, consistent version files and the CI rule of item 3. A failed check refuses. Queued PRs and armed auto-merge are reported, not refused.
- [ ] Approve. After the local cut made release commit R with tree T, the run shows the version, B, T and the promoted CHANGELOG section, then mints one `release-publish` grant with target `<version>@<T>` and an operator-chosen `--expires`, and optionally one `release-promote-latest` grant. On a TTY it uses the existing mint path (typed `mint`). Without a TTY it stops and prints the mint commands; `--resume` continues. The run records the grant ids. No new template and no new default expiry.
- [ ] Given readiness, then it prints that CI reuse is provisional and about how long the full local check takes; given a latest required check attempt that failed or is missing at readiness, then readiness says before the mint that the full local check will run.
- [ ] Given readiness and the dry run pass and the operator mints once, when the run continues, then no later phase prompts the operator unless a phase fails.
- [ ] Given the run ends, then it prints the pin PR, `release:local-update` and `npm i -g` commands.

Refs #6845

Depends on: S1 (#6791) and S2 (#6875).

narratives.UserStory: As a release operator, I want one `deft release:run <version>` command that checks readiness, cuts locally, asks me for one up-front mint and then runs the rest without prompting, so that a stable cut no longer pulls me back in at every phase.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. packages/core/src/release/run.ts: flags, help and the phase runner (readiness, setup, local cut, approve, push and open the release PR, review wait and merge, finish, npm publish watch, draft flip, promote only with its grant) and the final print of the pin PR, release:local-update and npm i -g commands (clauses 1, 6).
2. packages/core/src/release/run-readiness.ts: Phase 1 checks, the Phase 2 dry run, a free tag, consistent version files and the CI reuse rule with the provisional and duration lines; queued PRs and armed auto-merge reported only (clauses 2, 4).
3. packages/core/src/release/run-record.ts: the run record (B, T, PR number, grant ids, completed phases) read and written under .deft-scratch/release-run/ (clause 3).
4. Approve: show version, B, T and the promoted CHANGELOG section; on a TTY run the existing deft authz:grant mint path for release-publish <version>@<T> with the operator's --expires (and optionally release-promote-latest); without a TTY print the commands and stop; --resume records the grant ids (clauses 3, 5).
5. packages/core/src/release/pipeline.ts and types.ts: a stopBeforePush config field so the local cut runs Steps 1 to 9 and commits without pushing.
6. packages/runtime/src/release-run.ts and dispatch.ts: register release-run with the release:run alias.
7. Colocated vitest suites for each item, and changelog fragment changelog.d/6876-release-run.md.
narratives.Traces: #6876 clauses 1-6 trace to #6845 lean 7032154033 clauses 1, 2, 4, 13, 15 and 31 (split comment 7048165729).
